description: This file provides utility functions within the Utils namespace for synchronizing and persisting file contents and JSON settings. It includes functions to flush file buffers, synchronize files to disk, and save JSON configuration data to a file, ensuring data persistence.

methods.name: void syncPersistFile(const string file)
methods.description: Synchronizes a file by opening it, flushing its buffer, and calling fsync to ensure data is written to disk.

methods.name: void persistJsonSettings(const string strFile,const string strKey,const JsonValue & jsValue)
methods.description: Persists a JSON value to a specified file under a given key, updating the file contents and then synchronizing to disk.

ctags.signature: (const string strFile,const string strKey,const JsonValue & jsValue)
